boole

Local LLM inference for JavaScript — run GGUF models on your own machine via llama.cpp, no API key or per-token cost required.

$npx @boole/cli 
$ boole run TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M "Explain what a boolean is in one sentence." --stream
pulling TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M... done (3.8 GB)
loading model... done (Metal, 35 layers offloaded)

A boolean is a data type that holds exactly one of two values — true or false — and is the foundation
of every conditional branch in every program you have ever run.

Your hardware, your latency

Inference runs on the machine that called it. No cold start, no round-trip to a datacenter, no queue. Metal on Apple Silicon, CUDA and Vulkan on Linux and Windows.

Any GGUF, any quant

Point Boole at a HuggingFace repo and a quantization pattern. It downloads the file, verifies the hash, and caches it locally. You pick the size/quality trade-off.

An npm install, not a daemon

npm i -g @boole/cli. No Docker container, no system service, no background process. It links against node-llama-cpp and loads the model on demand.

Commands

run

Run a prompt against a model.

FlagDescription
--model, -mModel specifier or local .gguf path
--streamStream tokens to stdout
--system, -sSystem prompt
--temp, -tSampling temperature (default: 0.8)
--ctx-sizeContext window in tokens (default: 2048)
--gpu-layersLayers to offload to GPU (default: all)
--max-tokensMaximum tokens to generate

pull

Download a model to the local cache.

FlagDescription
--model, -mModel specifier
--dirCustom cache directory

serve

Start an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server.

FlagDescription
--model, -mModel specifier or local .gguf path
--port, -pPort (default: 8080)
--hostBind address (default: 127.0.0.1)
Warning: serve binds to 127.0.0.1 by default. Setting --host 0.0.0.0 exposes the model endpoint to your entire network with no authentication. Do not expose it to the public internet.

list

List downloaded models.

FlagDescription
--jsonOutput as JSON

Model specifiers

Models are addressed as <hf-repo>:<quant-pattern>.

TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M

Downloads the Q4_K_M quantization of Llama 2 7B from TheBloke's HuggingFace repo.

bartowski/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-GGUF:Q5_K_S

Downloads Phi-3 Mini at Q5_K_S quantization.

A local .gguf file path works anywhere a specifier does:

$boole run ./mistral-7b-q4.gguf "your prompt"
